originality.rationale: A full-parameter exact Bayes risk and a unique optimum in the natural symmetric two-site class for bridge positive occupation were not located in targeted mathematical-record searches and primary-literature comparisons. The known Gaussian quadrant identity, earlier one-sign occupation facts, and unrelated one-bit Gaussian channel-estimation formulas are acknowledged; these do not state the nonlinear two-sign path-occupation theorem. The novelty conclusion is best knowledge, not certification of priority.
residual_risks: Earlier equivalent formulas may appear under sojourn-time sampling, excursion conditioning, or nonlinear Gaussian functional regression terminology.

The mathematical tools are standard, so the originality claim is specifically for the combined exact two-sign occupation-risk theorem and strict symmetric-design optimization, not for Gaussian arcsine projection itself.
